verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents in-pipeline capture of both sides' audio via AudioBufferProcessor and transcript collection via turn events, so recordings and transcripts can be obtained programmatically in the bot code. However, it gives you capture primitives only: the evidence shows no built-in storage or retrieval API for pulling every call's recording and transcript after the fact, so the platform engineer has to build persistence and retrieval themselves. Missing for 10: managed storage or retrieval API for past calls, evidence of automatic coverage of every call, independent or hands-on corroboration.
